title: 89. Bailey Stanworth on Social Media + Mental Health: Societal Influence, Creating Boundaries, & Virtual Vulnerability
description_html:
Today's guest is Bailey Stanworth—founder of PLAY digital, co-host of What Day is It?, and a self-proclaimed accidental influencer! In this episode, we take a deep dive into Bailey's mental health and body image journey, how society influences self-esteem, setting boundaries as you consume content, mood-boosting follow recommendations, being vulnerable online vs. in-person, advice for SMMs/creators, and more!

Bailey's Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/baileyjst/

What Day is It: https://whatdayisitpodcast.com/

PLAY Digital: https://www.instagram.com/playdigital/

This week's DBT Skill is Mindfulness (Participate/Observe/Describe + Nonjudgementally/Effectively/One-Mindfully! Learn more here: https://dialecticalbehaviortherapy.com/mindfulness/

summary: sadie sits down with bailey stanworth—founder of play digital, podcast host, and self-described accidental influencer—to talk about navigating social media and mental health. they discuss bailey's journey with body image and an eating disorder, how societal pressures shaped her self-esteem, and what finally pushed her to prioritize her mental health. bailey shares practical advice on curating your feed to boost your mood, setting boundaries with content consumption, the difference between being vulnerable online versus in person, and tips for anyone wanting to pursue social media as a career. they also talk about what's actually helped bailey—therapy, medication, checking in with herself daily—and what she wishes she'd done sooner.
